_comment: Ranked free / 'boosted' brawlers — the maxed brawlers everyone may use in Ranked this season, scraped from the release-notes 'Ranked' section by backend/bsdraft/collect/boosted.py (the boosted-watch CI job). 'active' is the current season; the serving layer resolves the names to ids and treats them as owned-at-full-loadout when personalizing. Hand-editable. All dates are UTC: a bare date means that whole UTC day, a full ISO datetime (e.g. 2026-08-19T10:00:00Z) pins the hour. 'valid_until' is the last moment a rotation serves (a bare date = through that day's end); it may sit on an entry or, legacy, at the top level for 'active'. An 'upcoming' entry may carry a hand-staged 'active_from': the loader hands over to it automatically from that moment (no API/blog exposes the live season, so the flip is human knowledge — stage it here rather than editing at midnight); until then, after valid_until, nothing serves — a deliberate fail-safe gap when the exact flip hour is unknown. An upcoming entry with no 'active_from' is never served, and one with no 'valid_until' is capped at 45 days past its start so an unmaintained file goes quiet instead of asserting a dead free set forever. 'grants' records brawlers made free OUTSIDE the seasonal rotation — the notes do not announce these — and survives a boosted-watch rewrite. A rewrite carries all these dates forward for seasons whose names still match.

grants.note: Free outside the seasonal rotation — no release note announced it. Detected from match data 2026-08-26: Nori went to 100.0% Power 11 across every ranked slot on 08-25 (18,956 slots) and 08-26 (5,903), with zero P9/P10, after sitting at 83-94% P11 since release. Her distinct-player reach doubled overnight (3.99% -> 8.79%). Season 2's rotation (Trunk/Willow/Kaze) is unaffected and still serves.
